prompt.text:
Implement a memory-only image cabinet and export exactly `{ createImageCabinet }` with CommonJS.

`createImageCabinet()` returns `{ add, list, remove }`. `add({ id, mime, bytes })` accepts a non-empty alphanumeric/hyphen ID, MIME type `image/jpeg` or `image/png`, and a non-empty `Uint8Array` or array of integer bytes from 0 through 255. It stores a copy and returns `{ fileName, size }`, using `.jpg` or `.png`. Generated filenames must be unique; duplicate IDs throw even when MIME types differ.

`list()` returns metadata `{ fileName, size }` in reverse insertion order. `remove(fileName)` deletes an exact stored filename and returns `true`; a missing or malformed name returns `false`. No returned value may expose stored byte data, and later mutation of input bytes must not affect the cabinet. A rejected addition must leave state unchanged.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
